ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Diantz Alternate Data Stream Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Compress target file into a cab file stored in the Alternate Data Stream (ADS) of the target file.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*diantz\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cab.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(":[^\]"))
